plan.title: Your plan for the month
plan.caption_km: This is an estimate made at the start, using the kilometers you entered. The minimums per ride come from it.
plan.caption_mi: This is an estimate made at the start, using the miles you entered. The minimums per ride come from it.

progress.title: Monthly goal
progress.howProfit: The profit is the same as "This month" on the home screen: what you earned minus the cost per {{unit}} of your shifts and your expenses.
progress.howFixed_km: Fixed costs, like insurance and loan payments, are spread across each kilometer, based on the kilometers you plan to drive this month.
progress.howFixed_mi: Fixed costs, like insurance and loan payments, are spread across each mile, based on the miles you plan to drive this month.
progress.howClosedMonth: That's why Closed month, in Reports, may show a different amount: it deducts the full fixed cost. If you drive less than planned, it will be lower than the profit shown here.
progress.howToday: Today's goal divides what was left at the start of the day by the remaining workdays. It doesn't change during the day.
